name: mock-locale
description: WireMock stand-in for an A2A 1.0 agent that answers in the language of the interface a message names (locale/v1, ADR 0085; local development only). It lists the extension and says which tag it was told.

extensions.description: Answers in the language of the interface the person reads, and says which tag it was told.

skills.name: Answer in a language
skills.description: Answers in the language the message names, and says which tag it read.
